name: Overthrust Wamsutter Expansion
researcher_notes: The Wamsutter Expansion Project (Questar Overthrust Pipeline, 77 miles of 36 inch pipe, 750 MMcf/d added, FERC docket CP06-423, completed December 2007) is in the EIA project list for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 471. It is a completed expansion of the Overthrust system. The existing row P6899 (MountainWest Gas Pipeline / Overthrust Gas Pipeline, operating) is recorded at 261 miles and 2,800 MMcf/d, which is far larger than the 77 mile loop and larger than the original system, so it appears to include the 2007 expansion. Treated as part of P6899, not a new row. Not confirmed from the FERC order: web search was unavailable in this run, and the only source is a single EIA release. A person could open the CP06-423 order to confirm that the 77 miles sit inside the 261 miles. Even if it does not, a completed 2007 line is not a new project and would need its own row only if the sheet lacks that pipe.
